summary: LANE 1 residual-class census (branch feature/genuine-price-kpi @ 7af40eb, worktree C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/smartcompare-kpi). 21 residual classes enumerated and every one REPRODUCED through the real runtime gates with ENABLE_EXACT_PRICE_GATE=true (default ON): _selection_match (price_service.py:5616), select_best (:5889), should_cache_price (:6139), the cache-read _cache_price_identity_ok (structured_comparison_service.py:720), and the display chokepoint is_price_showable(enforce_correctness=True) (:1313). Raw probe JSON in the session scratchpad (residual_census_results.json, census_batch2.json, se_year_reprobe.json). Structural shape of the results: the 5 decision points collapse into TWO enforcement strengths — (A) the brand-aware full _selection_match at selection/select_best/cache-write (airtight for token-DISTINGUISHABLE classes), and (B) the axis-only _backstop_identity_ok (:5800) + _category_type_added (:4254) at cache-read/display, which leaks EVERY class whose discriminator is not an explicit numeric/qualifier axis. Census outcome: 5 FULL leaks passing all 5 points (gender flanker base->femme, one-sided SPF, makeup one-sided formula, apparel bare size-letter, Disney-Stitch construction — the last two were previously undocumented at full-leak severity), 9 BACKSTOP-ONLY leaks (Sauvage->Elixir, GoodGirl->Supreme, AF1->Air Max 1, AirPods Pro->Pro 2 both directions, iPhone-SE year-both-stated, gender both-stated Homme<->Femme, femme-query-unconfirmed, Size-M-vs-Size-XL, candidate-omits-query-axis, titleless-price), 6 OVER-REJECTIONS of correct products (ZMA/Cal-Mag acronym — rejected at ALL 5 points including display; hyphen-vs-space Omega-3 both directions; SE-year-add fail-closed; Switch-Light colourway; cross-unit g<->ml both directions — now ENFORCED fail-closed at all 5 points, upgraded from the old xfail; ReDoS-cap), plus the ladder-exposure F1 amplifier (verified: build_adapter_search_terms('Versace Eros Eau de Toilette 100ml','fragrances') -> ['...','Eros'], flag default ON). One prior-session confound corrected: the SE-year/AirPods display probes at 25 BHD were being pended by is_implausible_high_value_price, NOT the identity backstop — at realistic amounts (95-180 BHD) they LEAK at display+cache-read. Fixed-baseline verified: flagship Sauvage->Parfum, both-stated SPF/finish, combo-add Calcium->Cal-Mag-Zinc all reject at all 5 points (the 6a cache-read hardening holds).

recommendations.title: Make the backstop compare the VariantDescriptor, not run more token rules
recommendations.detail: 9 of the 21 census classes are BACKSTOP-ONLY leaks (Elixir/Supreme, AF1->AirMax1, AirPods Pro->Pro 2, SE-year-both-stated, gender-both-stated, femme-query, Size-M-vs-XL prefixed, candidate-omits-axis, titleless) — every one is already correctly decided by machinery that exists at the STRONG gates but is strict_extras-gated or token-identity-based and therefore absent from _backstop_identity_ok (price_service.py:5800) + _category_type_added (:4254). Wave-2's highest-leverage move: extract a VariantDescriptor {gender, concentration_line(+flanker enum), spf, model_year, generation, size_letter, net_content{value,unit_class}, formula_line, constituents, colorway, flavour} per side ONCE, and have the display chokepoint (is_price_showable :1421-1424) and cache-read (scs.py:753-756) compare DESCRIPTOR FIELDS. This is structurally different from the failed full-superset attempt (which over-rejected descriptive titles): field comparison only fires when a field is EXTRACTED on the relevant side(s), preserving each rule's existing asymmetry (one-sided-tolerated vs both-stated-reject vs add-reject). The gender-both-stated, prefixed-size, omitted-axis and year classes are decidable TODAY with existing extractors — zero new reference data needed.

recommendations.title: The 5 FULL-leak classes need reference data or bounded conditionality, not axes
recommendations.detail: gender flanker base->femme, one-sided SPF, makeup one-sided formula are the documented HELD tradeoffs — each needs the design doc's curated-reference + narrow-LLM-hint (is the base of this line men's? is this base product a sunscreen? does this line have formula sub-lines?). The census ADDS two full-leak classes not previously ranked at this severity: (a) apparel BARE size-letter (Shirt M vs XL) leaks at ALL 5 points — only a retailer structured size field decides it (6thstreet/namshi Algolia sizes facets and Woo Store-API attributes are RECEIVED but unparsed today); (b) Disney-Stitch/Stitched leaks at ALL 5 points via the unconditional _FASHION_CONSTRUCTION_TOLERATED tokens (:5481) — the cheap fix is the proven RS5 bigram-conditional pattern (tolerate stitch/stitched only inside a sewing-context bigram), NOT a descriptor field; do it early, it is selection-level.

recommendations.title: Over-rejections are the KPI/coverage movers: acronym table + hyphen fold first
recommendations.detail: ZMA/Cal-Mag: rejected at ALL 5 points (verified — the correct product can never display or cache); a deterministic acronym->constituents alias table feeding VariantDescriptor.constituents closes it with no LLM. Hyphen-vs-space (Omega-3 vs Omega 3): rejected BOTH directions at the 3 strong gates — a tokenizer-level digit-hyphen fold (emit both glued+split forms) in _identity_tokens_ps/normalize_words; high frequency (Omega-3/B-12/Co-Q10 class), also a cache-key-parity hazard; needs a both-directions sweep before landing. Switch-Light colourway: read the color attribute the wired extra-Unbxd/sharafdg-Algolia responses already carry -> VariantDescriptor.colorway (the xfail explicitly forbids weakening the variant-add guard instead). SE-year-add ('iPhone SE' vs '(2022)') is deliberately fail-closed — reopening it needs a latest-generation-default reference, defer.

recommendations.title: Unlock candidate-side structured codes (drop the query-confirmed-only constraint via a registry, and stamp noon sku)
recommendations.detail: The generation/related-model classes (AirPods Pro->Pro 2, AF1->AirMax1) are token-indistinguishable at the backstop but retailers EXPOSE discriminating codes: algolia stamps structured_code (algolia_service.py:532), noon has hit.sku (noon_service.py:206, NOT stamped onto the price dict — a 1-line win), magento/footlocker carry style codes. query_confirmed_structured_code (:5988) deliberately ignores codes absent from the query (consumer queries never carry MTJV3) — a Wave-2 descriptor can instead compare CANDIDATE codes across the pair of candidates or against a small curated model registry (Pro vs Pro 2 code stems), which is exactness evidence the query-confirmed rule structurally cannot use.

recommendations.title: Warmer-activation framing: which leaks actually gate the flip
recommendations.detail: New warmed writes go through should_cache_price (strong gate — verified rejecting all backstop-leak classes), so the cache-read backstop leaks fire only on POISONED/legacy/bypass entries; the fresh-purge precondition plus descriptor-hardened cache-read covers that. The DISPLAY leaks are the live risk with or without the warmer: converted_usd/page-scrape/iHerb/cached-Zyte paths reach is_price_showable without ever running _selection_match. The ladder-F1 amplifier (verified: core term 'Eros'/'Sauvage', flag default ON) raises the retrieval frequency of the full-leak classes — closing gender/concentration-flanker in the descriptor retires the F1 consideration; the interim rollback is ENABLE_ADAPTER_QUERY_LADDER=false. Also decide design-doc folded-item #4: titleless display (currently shows URL-only prices) — either flip ENABLE_PRICE_TITLE_PERSIST (migration 033, built on PR #12) or fail-close the display calibration.
